headline: Fisherman's Row Rekindles as Stlican Shelf Slips From Warden Hands
war_summary: Since our last edition, the guns of Fisherman's Row have opened afresh: three exchanges in the past two hours, the newest filed close to press time, with the Colonials now holding six of nine posts to the Wardens' three. On the Stlican Shelf the Wardens have slipped to two of nine, one base in ruins, and Breaker Town — twenty-five events in a day — remains the storm-centre, firing hot into the afternoon. Callahan's Passage, by contrast, has cooled: the Wardens now count all ten posts, their last exchange recorded near half past one. In the Weathered Expanse the five-four line holds, but the butcher's bill climbs — Warden losses running near eight hundred an hour against some three hundred Colonial — around Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest. The Nevish Line now shows a ruin, one base gone to no-man's-land, as Colonial losses accelerate past four hundred an hour at Grief Mother and Tomb Father. Linn Mercy, long quiet, has flared steeply; Mooring County's guns have fallen silent since mid-morning, though its toll stays heavy. It is day 407; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
